name: Community Organizer

sections.daily_work: Mobilize community members around shared issues and causes. Build coalitions, plan campaigns, facilitate meetings, and advocate for policy changes at the local level.
sections.learning: Community engagement strategies, campaign planning, public speaking, facilitation, grassroots advocacy, understanding of local government and civic processes.
sections.pay: Varies widely depending on organization and funding. Entry-level often starts around $30,000-$45,000 USD. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Volunteering with community groups, internships with advocacy organizations, building facilitation and public speaking skills, no specific degree required but related fields help.

try_in_real_life: Attend a local town hall or community meeting and observe
Organize a small campaign around an issue in your school or neighborhood
Practice facilitating a group discussion on a topic you care about
Research local advocacy groups and their current campaigns
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
